infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: ParrotKit uses the camera to record creator recipe takes with on-screen shooting cues.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: ParrotKit uses the microphone only when you record video takes that include audio.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: ParrotKit can save selected recipe takes to your photo library when you choose to export them.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: ParrotKit can access videos you choose from your library to attach as recipe takes or references.
